description: Mary Ungs-Sogaard is a candidate for Iowa Senate District 33. A lifelong resident of the district, she grew up in Luxemburg, Iowa, and built a career in local journalism and community service. She helped establish The Kid Project childcare center and has supported it for more than 35 years. Mary is running to provide honest leadership, listen to constituents, and focus on practical solutions for Iowa families.
title: Meet Mary | Mary Ungs-Sogaard for Iowa
